name: Joji Mabuchi
role: Pit hand, the oldest on the night crew
description:
The oldest pit hand on the night crew: a grey-green goblin with big drooping ears, grease in every crease and a rag over one shoulder, who sucks his teeth before he disagrees with anything and talks to the Frame's leg as if it could hear him. Slow, gravelly and grumbling, with a joke hidden inside every second complaint.

He wants the job done properly, which means his way, and to be home before the trams start.
